The northern '''Lumbridge cow field''' is a field containing [[cows]], [[Cow calf|cow calves]], a [[dairy cow]], and attackable [[farmers]] located in the north of [[Lumbridge]]. This is a good place to train [[combat skills]] at low levels and can be preferred over the [[Lumbridge cow field|eastern cow field]] or [[Fred's farm]] due to more players training in those fields in [[free-to-play]]. This place is also a good place for early [[Prayer]] training due to the bones dropped by the cows.

==Transportation==
The easiest mode of transportation for a new player is to teleport to Lumbridge using either the [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Teleport]] spell, and walk north from there.
